status: source plan; execution workflow not yet qualified

selection.source: Reviewed exact Git commit and app/data/images.json SHA256
selection.eligible: Unique green catalogue ID; registry GHCR over default verified TLS
selection.root: Retain raw root metadata observed once; later producer must use repository@sourceDigest

proposedExecutionPhase.reviewRequired: Concrete metadata artifact hash, exact root/child/config/layer descriptors, source closure and capacity observations
proposedExecutionPhase.storeDriver: vfs in exclusive root-owned store, no default store reuse
proposedExecutionPhase.completionQualification: 40 GiB is a hard ceiling, not evidence that expansion will fit. Collect actual per-stage usage and refuse exhaustion. Later resize needs a separately reviewed bound.
proposedExecutionPhase.freeSpaceGuard: Owned supervisor monitors actual scratch statvfs every second, terminates only its recorded process group at the reserve threshold and waits/reaps. Preserve failure stage and return code.
proposedExecutionPhase.producer: Run actual make-bundle.sh with the reviewed pinned root ref; no fixture redirection. Revalidate complete root/selected chain and all config/layer bytes against reviewed plan before import.
proposedExecutionPhase.offlineImport: Root-owned unshare network namespace, loopback only, no routes; observe socket ENETUNREACH before and after. Run executable wrapper binding every Podman operation to the owned store. Import local OCI and independently inspect exact selected ref ID/digest.
proposedExecutionPhase.readback: Full bundle verification plus manifest/config/layer hash-size inventory and actual imported ID/digest. No container execution or selected OS boot assertion.
proposedExecutionPhase.retention: Bounded public proof only, <=4 MiB; no full layer artifact. Retain complete metadata, source/run identity, capacity samples, process/reap receipts and numeric failure status.
proposedExecutionPhase.cleanup: Trap cancellation/failure, stop and reap only owned group, verify mount source/loop backing inode before unmount/detach. Remove only exclusive scratch after bounded proof export. No global reclaim or prune. Retain metadata and original failed evidence.
